zh_lead: 点击右上角铃铛查看通知。红点表示有未读提醒，与论文问题的严重程度无关。
en_lead: Select the bell in the page header to open Notifications. A red dot indicates unread notifications, not a critical thesis finding.
zh_steps: 核对通知中的文件名、时间及事件，例如报告已生成、邮件已发送、检测失败或邮件发送失败。
点击对应的“查看报告”，进入该文件的报告。
处理后可选择“全部已读”。标记已读只改变提醒状态，不删除报告。
en_steps: Check the filename, time and event, such as Report ready, Report email sent, a failed review or failed email delivery.
Select View report on the relevant notification to open that file's report.
Use Mark all read after checking the notifications. Marking a notification as read does not delete the report.
zh_note: “邮件已发送”表示邮件服务器已接收，不保证收件箱立即显示。报告是否可读，请直接查看站内通知或历史报告。
en_note: Report email sent means the mail server accepted the message, not that it is already visible in your inbox. Check Notifications or Report history directly for the report.
zh_caption: 铃铛、未读红点、文件名与全部已读
en_caption: Bell, unread indicators, filenames and Mark all read

zh_title: 设置语言、外观与退出登录
zh_lead: 点击左下角用户卡片，选择“设置”。语言和外观可分别调整，不改变已上传论文或检测判断。
en_lead: Open the user menu at the lower left and select Settings. Language and appearance are separate preferences; they do not change the thesis or review decisions.
zh_steps: 语言选择“简体中文”或 English，界面与报告说明随之切换；英文说明准备时请稍候。
外观选择浅色、深色或跟随系统。“跟随系统”采用设备当前的深浅色偏好；登录页插图不受影响。
选择后点击“完成”退出设置。需要离开账号时，在用户菜单选择“退出登录”。
en_steps: Choose 简体中文 or English. Interface text and report explanations follow the selection; allow time for English explanations to prepare.
Choose Light, Dark or System. System follows your device's light/dark preference. The sign-in illustration is unaffected.
Select Done to leave Settings. To leave the account, select Sign out in the user menu.
zh_note: 原文引文和文件名不翻译。导出取开始下载时的语言，通知邮件取提交检测时的语言。
en_note: Quotations and filenames are not translated. Exports use the language at the start of download; emails use the language at submission.
zh_caption: 用户菜单及语言、外观设置
en_caption: User menu, language and appearance settings

zh_lead: 整体体验、界面、响应速度或稳定性问题，可通过右上角“使用反馈”提交。此入口不同于某条结果的点赞、点踩。
en_lead: For feedback about the overall experience, interface, response speed or reliability, select Feedback in the page header. This is separate from rating an individual finding.
zh_steps: 选择整体满意度星级，此项必填。
勾选需改进的方面，可多选；按需补充说明，最多 1000 字。
点击“提交反馈”，等待成功提示。写清操作步骤、预期与实际现象，有助于维护人员理解。
en_steps: Choose an overall satisfaction rating. This is required.
Select any areas that could be improved and add comments if useful, up to 1,000 characters.
Select Submit feedback and wait for confirmation. Describe the steps, expected behaviour and actual result to help maintainers understand the issue.
zh_note: 不要填写密码、验证码或其他敏感凭据。论文具体结果的问题，优先在对应结果卡片内反馈。
en_note: Do not include passwords, verification codes or other sensitive credentials. Use the relevant finding card for feedback about a specific finding.
zh_caption: 使用反馈入口、评分、改进方面与提交
en_caption: Feedback entry, rating, improvement areas and submission

en_title: Open a report from an email
zh_lead: 报告生成后，系统向账号对应的通知邮箱发送提醒邮件，提供报告入口，不需要回复。
en_lead: After a report is generated, the system sends a notification to the email address associated with your account. The email provides a report link and does not require a reply.
zh_steps: 核对标题中的系统名称及论文文件名，确认是本次报告。
点击“查看检测报告”。如需登录，使用提交该论文时的账号。
邮件及按钮语言采用提交检测时的界面语言，登录过程也保留该语言。
en_steps: Check the system name in the subject and the thesis filename to identify the report.
Select View report. If prompted, sign in with the account that submitted the thesis.
The email and button use the interface language selected at submission. That language is retained through sign-in.
zh_note: 没收到邮件时，先查垃圾邮件，并直接登录网站查看历史报告。中途切换界面语言不会改变已提交任务的邮件语言。
en_note: If no email arrives, check your spam folder and sign in to view Report history directly. Switching language later does not change the email language of an already submitted review.
zh_caption: 报告通知邮件、文件名与报告链接
en_caption: Report notification email, filename and report link
